SPECIFICATIONS

• NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 1650 GPU 
• 896 CUDA cores 
• 4GB GDDR5 memory 
• 128-bit memory bus 
• Engine boost clock: 1665 MHz 
• Memory clock: 8.0 Gbps 
• PCI Express 3.0 

DIMENSIONS

• Length: 160mm (6.3in) 
• Height: 111.15mm (4.38in) /70mm (2.76in) (with low profile bracket)

• User Manual 
• Low Profile Bracket 

POWER REQUIREMENTS • 300-watt power supply recommended • 75-watt max power consumption

CONNECTIONS

• DisplayPort 1.4 
• HDMI 2.0b 
• Dual Link DVI-D 
• Triple simultaneous display capable 

SOFTWARE COMPATIBILITY

• Game Ready Drivers 
• Microsoft DirectX 12 API, Vulkan API 
• OpenGL 4.5 
• Microsoft Windows 10/7 x64 

FEATURES

• Low Profile Ready 
• 4K Ready 
• 40mm Twin Fan 
• NVIDIA® Ansel 
• NVIDIA® G-SYNC®compatible 

EAN: 4895173618840 UPC: 810012080552

### GEFORCE® GTX 1650 Low Profile

GET FAST and GAME STRONG with the all-new generation of ZOTAC GAMING GeForce GTX graphics cards. Based on the new NVIDIA Turing architecture, it’s packed with GDDR5 fast memory. Now get all that performance in a low profile form factor fit for height restricted spaces.

#### SKU: ZT-T16500H-10L
